page.overview:
Who is Hans Kanatarou?

Hans Kanatarou (ハンスかなたろう Hansu Kanatarou?) is the character from the 12th Street Fighter Laboratory corner. A man who loves to eat, having eight meals a day. He has a German mother and a Japanese father. It appears he is training to become a ninja. So far his only technique is 忍法 喉仏.
